info.name: EstateSync API
info.description: EstateSync real-estate platform. Run folders in order: 00 System → 01 Auth → 02 KYC → 03 Admin KYC → 04 Admin Staff → 05 Become Owner → 06 Stripe → 07 Properties → 08 Admin Properties → 09 Tenant Financial Profile → 10 Admin Financial Profile → 11 Rental Applications → 12 Leases → 13 Payments → 14 Complaints → 15 Audit Logs. All tokens and IDs are captured automatically.

pm.test('Owner role assigned or already owner', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));

if (res.data && res.data.propertyId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('propertyId', res.data.propertyId); console.log('propertyId', res.data.propertyId); }
